limitations: The writer had task-level access restrictions, not an OS filesystem sandbox. Historical/corpus page and source-SHA-1 exclusion does not prove pretraining disjointness. The reviewer saw frozen expected observations and variants but based findings on actual images and preserved answer disagreements. Evidence quotes are checked mechanically; qualitative judgments remain model-authored. Raw answers, keys and snapshots remain unchanged. No overall case pass labels or aggregated quality percentage are assigned.

review_protocol.sampling: Purposive selection for varied scenes from newly retrieved Commons category members, excluding historical cases, materialized/reviewed candidates and teaching sources by normalized source page and original SHA-1. Six unchanged images and one each of six declared integrity transformations; community categories are sampling metadata, not aesthetic truth.
review_protocol.writer_inputs: Only isolated protocol/teaching assets, anonymized image files and blind-inputs.jsonl. No prior turns, case metadata, answer key, source names, transformation recipes or review findings. Exactly one child agent, no further delegation.
review_protocol.freeze: Parent visually writes and freezes localized expected observations against actual materialized images before writer begins. All writer responses and protocol inputs are SHA-256 bound before evaluation. Neither responses nor key may be rewritten to improve the first-pass result.
review_protocol.evidence: Each case needs two visible anchors, verbatim response quotes and a field-specific explanation. Every field is supported, partial, failed or unresolved; never bulk-assign grades or count keyword presence as a visual-quality pass.
review_protocol.completion: Review all twelve frozen outputs, report concrete failures and uncertainty, make only supported narrow fixes if needed, verify affected code and deliver the audit. Any feedback-aware retry is a regression check, not a fresh blind pass. No release-level success percentage from twelve purposively chosen cases.

bindings.scope: Hash and quote checks only; all qualitative findings are manually authored model review.
